notes.title: Developer Update
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey there![/b][/p][p]I'll be using this space to share updates from time to time on the game's progress.[/p][p]Lately, I’ve been focused on improving the art and visual effects based on earlier feedback. It’s been a bit of a rollercoaster. The upside of being a solo developer/artist is that I get to experiment and have fun trying new things. The downside? I have to do [i]all[/i] the work myself.[/p][p]I also made what might have been a dumb (or maybe smart) decision to upgrade my project to a newer engine version. Thankfully, it didn’t explode! In fact, it has actually improved my workflow and sped up testing, though I did lose some initial time wrestling with bugs from the upgrade.[/p][p]Anyway, here’s a backdrop of some scenery I just created to give you a feel for how the art is shaping up. Hope you like it![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506815/eb057aa166f8b4f1dfd772e003ec68d805de2625.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 🛠️ Playtest Wrap-Up - Thank You for Participating!
notes.notes:
[b]The playtest has ended![/b]
Huge thanks to everyone who jumped in and gave it a try. Your feedback has been incredibly helpful, and I’ve already started making changes based on what I’ve heard.

One piece of feedback I received mentioned the UI, so here’s a quick look at one of the updates in progress (screenshot below) 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45506815/b72d05da8f5ce6131bba225c58bb34d927d78610.jpg[/img]

I’ll keep sharing progress as things evolve. If you haven’t already, wishlist the game to stay in the loop!

-DC

notes.title: Public Playtest Is Now Live!
notes.notes:
[b]Hey everyone![/b]

I'm incredibly excited to announce that the [b]Rogue Drone Hunter[/b] [b]Public Playtest[/b] is officially [b]LIVE[/b] on Steam!

If you enjoy breaking things, I need brave souls like [i]YOU[/i] to help test the game. Spot something weird, like an enemy flying out of bounds or your character getting stuck in a wall? Or maybe you ran into a talking dog that wasn't supposed to be there (or was it...)? Let us know! Share your feedback in our [b]Discord[/b] or [b]Steam Forums[/b] and help us squash those pesky bugs.

There's also an [b]in-game feedback form[/b], in case you're too lazy (like me) to open another tab.

[b]The playtest runs from April 7 to May 7[/b], so don’t wait too long. I might run out of coffee at any moment!

Cheers,
[b]DC[/b]

notes.title: Welcome to Rogue Drone Hunter...
notes.notes:
Greetings, Hunters!

We’re thrilled to finally introduce Rogue Drone Hunter, a unique fusion of real-time action roguelike and turn-based deckbuilding combat.  If you love intense bullet-hell action and deep card game strategy, this game is for you!
